name: Setsuna and the Sealed City of Immortals
source:
Setsuna and her handler have been separated while entering a deadly sealed town.

With the help of a crew of girls with awesome powers, all from different worlds and timelines, she must find him and escape.

But will he hold on until then?

[From [url=https://karita0101.itch.io/setsuna-and-the-sealed-city-of-immortals]itch.io[/url]]
